value.statement: The test cartridge shall remain closed throughout the collection sequence.
value.acceptance_criterion: Inspect seal position before and after every run; any open state fails the run.
value.failure_disposition: Seal wear can invalidate collection evidence.

value.statement: The chamber controller shall inhibit a sequence outside the approved pressure envelope.
value.acceptance_criterion: Inject out-of-envelope pressure and observe inhibition before actuator enable.
value.failure_disposition: A failed sensor must not be interpreted as nominal pressure.

value.statement: The heater controller shall stop heating when the configured temperature limit is reached.
value.acceptance_criterion: Command heating at the configured limit and verify shutdown within one control cycle.
value.failure_disposition: Temperature overshoot requires a documented disposition.

value.statement: Actuator power shall require an independent enabled interlock.
value.acceptance_criterion: Remove interlock permission and verify zero actuator-enable commands.

value.statement: An emergency-stop request shall supersede an active extraction command.
value.acceptance_criterion: Issue emergency stop during each sequence state and verify a latched stop.
value.failure_disposition: Reset shall not resume the interrupted sequence.

value.statement: Every sample container shall carry a unique identifier linked to its run.
value.acceptance_criterion: Reconcile all collected containers to run identifiers with no duplicates.
value.failure_disposition: Unidentified material is excluded from reported recovery.

value.statement: Each material campaign shall include an empty-cartridge blank run.
value.acceptance_criterion: Verify blank-run completion and contamination disposition before material runs.
value.failure_disposition: A contaminated blank invalidates subsequent interpretation.

value.statement: The run record shall include input, recovered, retained, and unaccounted mass.
value.acceptance_criterion: Confirm the four quantities reconcile within the approved balance tolerance.
value.failure_disposition: Unaccounted mass is not recovered product.

value.statement: Controller and instrument events shall share a synchronized run clock.
value.acceptance_criterion: Verify clock offset is no greater than 100 milliseconds in the acceptance run.
value.failure_disposition: Misaligned events can reverse apparent causality.

value.statement: The controller shall flag any telemetry gap longer than two seconds.
value.acceptance_criterion: Inject a three-second gap and verify a flagged run-quality event.
value.failure_disposition: A flagged gap requires review before accepting results.

value.statement: The run header shall record controller, cartridge, and sensor revisions.
value.acceptance_criterion: Verify complete revision fields on every accepted run.
value.failure_disposition: Mixed revisions prevent comparable campaign results.

value.statement: Mass and temperature measurements shall use current approved calibrations.
value.acceptance_criterion: Reject an expired calibration during pre-run checks.
value.failure_disposition: Calibration drift can be mistaken for extraction improvement.

value.statement: Restart after an abort shall require a new pre-run checklist.
value.acceptance_criterion: Attempt direct resume after abort and verify rejection.
value.failure_disposition: An interrupted run shall retain its original failed status.

value.statement: Exported run data shall include units, channel names, and quality flags.
value.acceptance_criterion: Reimport a completed run and compare all channel metadata and flags.
value.failure_disposition: Numeric values without units are not acceptable evidence.

value.statement: Only an authorized operator shall acknowledge a safety hold.
value.acceptance_criterion: Attempt acknowledgment with a read-only account and verify denial.
value.failure_disposition: A hold is not cleared by changing the view.

sections.heading: RegolithWorks 4.0
sections.text:
Thermal-Vacuum Commissioning

Defined ground evidence before the next mission decision.

sections.heading: The decision problem
sections.text:
Changing inputs and configurations make results difficult to compare.

Current development risk: chamber contamination.

Ground chambers cannot reproduce every small-body condition.

sections.heading: A controlled campaign boundary
sections.text:
Establish repeatable blank runs before interpreting recovered material.

Scope: Controlled ground-test use.

Accepted evidence and unresolved dependencies stay separate.

sections.heading: Containment and safe control
sections.text:
Containment: The test cartridge shall remain closed throughout the collection sequence.

Pressure envelope: The chamber controller shall inhibit a sequence outside the approved pressure envelope.

Thermal limit: The heater controller shall stop heating when the configured temperature limit is reached.

Power interlock: Actuator power shall require an independent enabled interlock.

Emergency stop: An emergency-stop request shall supersede an active extraction command.

sections.heading: Evidence and configuration
sections.text:
Sample custody: Every sample container shall carry a unique identifier linked to its run.

Blank control: Each material campaign shall include an empty-cartridge blank run.

Mass accounting: The run record shall include input, recovered, retained, and unaccounted mass.

Time synchronization: Controller and instrument events shall share a synchronized run clock.

Telemetry continuity: The controller shall flag any telemetry gap longer than two seconds.

sections.heading: Recovery and acceptance
sections.text:
Configuration control: The run header shall record controller, cartridge, and sensor revisions.

Calibration freshness: Mass and temperature measurements shall use current approved calibrations.

Recovery restart: Restart after an abort shall require a new pre-run checklist.

Data export: Exported run data shall include units, channel names, and quality flags.

Operator authority: Only an authorized operator shall acknowledge a safety hold.
